Weapon Lvl is this gun's level. Unlocks carry over to compatible guns, so a part you've already unlocked on another gun is ready to use.
Build: sources disagree
We list our main stat tracker's top Multiplayer build, which it changed for Season 1 on Nov 6. It pairs the build with the KG-7 Drillcharge Apex. A second stat tracker's Long Range build (Nov 4) shares the Ivanov QR600, TT Baem 12" and TT Type 40 Comb, and runs the KT76 Light Bolt and Cronen R808 instead. It hasn't changed that build since Season 1. The early build is that second tracker's low-level build, and our main stat tracker gives the same slot and unlock level (weapon Lvl 4 to 14) for all five parts.
Tier: sources disagree
Our main stat tracker rates it "Absolute Meta". A second stat tracker also ranks it the best sniper, but in its A tier.
